criteria.title: Divergence-free Fourier 기저
criteria.text:
2π 주기영역에서k·ûk=0, û−k=conj(ûk), Pk=I−kkᵀ/|k|²를사용한다. k=0은별도mean equation이다. 합격: 제약이초
기·각accepted step에서유지되고pressure 회복에div f가포함된다. 이branch의periodic domain을whole-space 논문
해와혼동하지않는다.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The independent 2pi-periodic Galerkin branch validates divergence and conjugate symmetry initially and at every accepted step, treats the zero mode separately and recovers pressure with div f.

criteria.title: 비선형 convolution과 dealiasing
criteria.text:
모든p+q=k 상호작용을계산한다. quadratic product는3/2 padding 또는그와동등한정확한retained-mode convolu-
tion을사용한다. 합격: 작은random solenoidal fixture에서direct convolution과FFT product가정규화10^−11 이내
일치한다. high-mode aliasing negative control이검출된다.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Every retained direct convolution interaction is included. Independently implemented padded 3D FFT agrees below 1e-11; an aliased high-mode negative control fails as intended, with an independent NumPy comparison.

criteria.title: 시간 적응과 에너지 안정성
criteria.text:
diffusion integrating factor/IMEX 등으로stiff linear term을처리하고advection CFL·embedded local error·energy
defect로step을승인한다. 합격: Taylor-Green의amplitude/energy를시간반분에서설계차수로수렴시킨다. dt를줄여
도사라지지않는energy defect는spatial/aliasing 오류로조사한다.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The IMEX method uses diffusion stability, advection CFL, embedded step-doubling and an energy-defect acceptance gate. Taylor-Green amplitude and energy converge at order two under timestep halving.

criteria.title: τ 기반 near-terminal sampling
criteria.text:
s=−logτ를주변수로쓰고τ>0만평가한다. normalized coordinates와velocity를계산한뒤physical scaling을적용한다.
합격: τ=10^−2,10^−4,10^−8,10^−12 예시와더작은값의precision mode가재현된다. 표시t가1로반올림돼도내
부τ>0 계약은유지한다.
remaining: Evaluate the actual reconstructed normalized velocity and physical scaling at these source-admissible points.
Supply a precision mode with source interval/tail bounds, not coordinates alone.
remainingObligations: Evaluate the actual reconstructed normalized velocity and physical scaling at these source-admissible points.
Supply a precision mode with source interval/tail bounds, not coordinates alone.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Exact decimal positive tau is preserved independently of rounded t, including 1e-2,1e-4,1e-8,1e-12,1e-40,1e-1000. Source normalized scales are carried symbolically.

criteria.title: 공간·급수·정밀도 적응
criteria.text:
core radius, axial length, pulse wavelength, active cutoff orders를함께해결한다. 각refinement 축을독립증가시킨
다. 합격: 2배grid, Fourier cutoff, coefficient order, arithmetic precision 비교표와별도tail bound를저장한다. 예산
초과시last-resolved τ와원인을표시한다.
remaining: Create independent source grid, Fourier cutoff, coefficient order and arithmetic precision comparisons.
Record the actual core/axial/pulse scales, active cutoffs, rigorous tail bound and last resolved positive tau.
remainingObligations: Create independent source grid, Fourier cutoff, coefficient order and arithmetic precision comparisons.
Record the actual core/axial/pulse scales, active cutoffs, rigorous tail bound and last resolved positive tau.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Finite Galerkin runtime budgets and last resolved time are reported. Independent FFT, time and NumPy checks execute, but the original pulse/coefficient precision refinement is absent.

criteria.title: 시각화·물리량 연결
criteria.text:
fixed physical bounds와normalized view를제공하고instantaneous streamlines/particle paths, 속도/각속도, core/
global energy를구분한다. 합격: 모든scene은실제run hash·샘플위치·단위·색범위·vector scale를갖는다. 자동확대나
vector 정규화가core 수축·성장을숨기지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope M3 Navier implementation and observed public UI review
remaining: Provide complete normalized/source views and explicit streamlines/particle, velocity/angular-velocity, core/whole-energy distinctions on the reconstruction path.
remainingObligations: Provide complete normalized/source views and explicit streamlines/particle, velocity/angular-velocity, core/whole-energy distinctions on the reconstruction path.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The actual finite Fourier run exports 81 positions/vectors, whole periodic energy curves, fixed bounds, units, color range, vector scale and linked hashes. The observed public N8 scene matches these 81 source samples, the z=0 slice, separate full periodic domain, common color range and actual vector multiplier 0.3. Keyboard/LOD preserve the mathematical digest. Complete paper-source observations remain unavailable.

criteria.title: Claim-test-proof 연결
criteria.text:
각관측량에원문reference, numerical test, analytic certificate, Lean theorem을별도링크한다. 합격: arbitrary
sampled array를axiom으로놓고PDE 해라고결론내리지않는다. certified approximation 표시는해당구간의error
enclosure와조건을요구한다.
remaining: Complete per-observation links across the source reconstruction and current UI.
Provide the actual interval-specific error enclosures and refinement proof before any certified-approximation label.
remainingObligations: Complete per-observation links across the source reconstruction and current UI.
Provide the actual interval-specific error enclosures and refinement proof before any certified-approximation label.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The result distinguishes source lineage, finite numerical execution, analytic certificate and Lean theorem. Missing analytic/Lean evidence remains null; forged formal authority and view mutations are rejected.

criteria.text:

logs를묶는다. 합격: 다른환경에서fixture와selected run이같은허용오차로재현된다. 이번문서작성턴의상태는설계
완료이며구현·사이트변경·배포완료로표시하지않는다.
